DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-Viral Bronchial Hyperreactivity (Cough Variant Asthma)

The normal FeNO, methacholine challenge, and peak flow suggest the obstruction is not due to chronic allergic asthma, COPD, or fixed airway disease. Given your recent URI and the specific pattern of exertional and nocturnal coughing, the diagnosis is post-viral bronchial hyperreactivity.
